test_std_exception: test that pybind11 translates a C++ std exception into a Python RuntimeError
test_cross_module_exceptions: test that pybind11 exceptions propagate correctly across separate compiled modules
test_custom: test custom pybind11 exception types including subclassing and helper-declared exceptions
test_nested_throws: test nested C++ to Python to C++ exception handling and translation
test_local_translator: test that a local pybind11 exception translator only applies within its own module
